scripts.db:migrate:dev: dotenv -e .env.development -- sh -c 'npm run db:guard && prisma migrate dev'
scripts.db:migrate:test: dotenv -e .env.test -- sh -c 'npm run db:guard && prisma migrate deploy'
scripts.db:reset:dev: dotenv -e .env.development -- sh -c 'npm run db:guard && prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed'
scripts.db:reset:test: dotenv -e .env.test -- sh -c 'npm run db:guard && prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed'
scripts.db:seed:dev: dotenv -e .env.development -- sh -c 'npm run db:guard && SEED_ZONE_ADJACENCY=true ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register prisma/seed.ts'
scripts.db:seed:test: dotenv -e .env.test -- sh -c 'npm run db:guard && SEED_ZONE_ADJACENCY=false ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register prisma/seed.ts'
